title: Siege of Kumamoto Castle
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Kumamoto Castle", at revision 1370742652, opens: "The siege of Kumamoto Castle  from February 19 to April 12, 1877, in Kumamoto, Japan, was a major battle of the Satsuma Rebellion." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7510168, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1877 Japanese military event". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
